name: Sunday
overview: Scripture highlights the significance of the first day of the week, which follows the Sabbath, as a time of holy convocation and rest from regular work, as seen in Exodus 12:16 and Exodus 35:2. This day gains special importance in the New Testament with the resurrection of Christ occurring at dawn on the first day of the week (Matthew 28:1), marking it as a day of celebration and worship. While the Old Testament emphasizes keeping the seventh day holy as the Sabbath (Exodus 20:8), the New Testament points to the first day as a time for commemorating Christ’s victory over death, which has shaped Christian practices such as Easter Sunday, Palm Sunday, and Sunday gatherings including Sunday school.
